title: Március 15.: A polgári forradalom és szabadságharc (March 15th: Civic Revolution & Freedom)
grammar: Commemorative Syntax, State Protocol & Solemn Historical Memorialization

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what March 15 commemorates and what happened in Pest in 1848.
I can name the Twelve Points and the National Song and say what the March youth demanded.
I can use alkalmából and tiszteletére to talk about a commemoration.
I can read a short text about 1848 and answer questions about it.
